description:
My name is Walt Harden.

I spent 35 years as a licensed contractor and home inspector. I have been inside over 10,000 American homes across 14 states. I have seen what fails, what lasts, and what the industry taught me never to say out loud.

This channel is everything I should have told every homeowner I ever worked for.

Modern homes are built to fail on a schedule. Modern appliances are engineered to the edge of their warranty. Modern contractors profit from both.

Home Guard is your defense.

New video every week. Subscribe if you want to know what the industry hoped you would never find out.

Stay guarded.
